name: Magmadar
notes: Frenzy (+150% attack speed for 8 s) is in the logs' swing rate, as much of it as the raids let through. Magma Spit (a Fire DoT on attackers), Panic (fear) and Lava Bomb are left out. Lava Breath's timer is assumed (the script triggers it with Frenzy in cmangos).
setup: Healers react in 0.30 s ± 25% and cancel heals over 50% overheal.
healingNotes: What the Anniversary Hardcore realms raids had on Magmadar (30 kills, Warcraft Logs): the median kill's raid of 40 with 1 tanks (0 of them on adds, who took 0 a second together, not in the events), 11 healers by Warcraft Logs' healer role (88% of the healing), each 328 HPS with overheal. The raid healed 1,760 a second (599 on the tanks, 1,058 on the rest, 47% overheal on the rest). Each non-tank took 23.6 a second after mitigation. Fight length is the 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile kill. For the healing sim to check its healer counts against.

name: Golemagg the Incinerator

Earthquake below 10% health and Pyroblast on random players are left out.

name: Vaelastrasz the Corrupt
notes: One tank's stint (Burning Adrenaline comes every 45 s), so the fight is his longest stretch on one tank in the logs. Flame Breath's DoT stacks to 5 (client data), which a sim DoT can't, so each stack is its own 1,000 Fire every 3 s, the stacks coming one a breath (every 7.5 s from 11 s) and staying up. Fire resistance takes its share of the Fire. The Burning Adrenaline on casters and the raid's Fire Nova on others are the healing sim's.

name: Ragnaros
notes: Elemental Fire is a proc on his landed hits, blocked ones too (proc aura 20563, client data), at the logs' rate: on the Anniversary realms about 3 in 4 of his swings, in Season of Discovery's Normal far fewer. Its DoT is 8 ticks of 600, restarted by the next hit. Fire resistance from gear and buffs takes its share. Wrath of Ragnaros (every 25 to 30 s, 1,000 Fire and a knockback that wipes threat, so a second tank picks him up) and the submerge phase are left out: one tank's stint between knockbacks is what's scored.
